records.original_message: This error indicates a problem with your origin web server, preventing it from fulfilling the request. The Error establishing database connection message is a common HTTP 500 error, typically indicating an origin web server issue. If you encounter this error, contact your hosting provider for assistance.

records.title: Error 501: not implemented

records.original_message: Cloudflare Workers returns a 501 error when a request uses an HTTP method that is not supported by the Workers Runtime. - A client sent a request to a Workers script using a custom or non-standard HTTP method (methods outside of GET, POST, PUT, etc.). - A typo in the HTTP method (for example, POT instead of POST).

records.title: Error 524: a timeout occurred
records.message: 错误 524 表示 Cloudflare 已成功连接到源 Web 服务器，但源在默认的 125 秒代理读取超时之前未提供 HTTP 响应。如果源服务器由于有太多工作要做（例如，大型数据查询）而花费太长时间，或者因为服务器正在争夺资源并且无法及时返回任何数据，则可能会发生这种情况。如果源 Web 服务器在建立连接后确认 (ACK) 资源请求，但未及时发送响应（在代理读取超时延迟内，默认情况下为 125 秒），则会出现错误 524。
records.original_message: Error 524 indicates that Cloudflare successfully connected to the origin web server, but the origin did not provide an HTTP response before the default 125 seconds Proxy Read Timeout. This can happen if the origin server is taking too long because it has too much work to do, for example, a large data query, or because the server is struggling for resources and cannot return any data in time. The error 524 occurs if the origin web server acknowledges (ACK) the resource request after the connection has been established, but does not send a timely response (within the Proxy Read Timeout delay, 125 seconds by default).
records.situation: 错误 524 表示 Cloudflare 已成功连接到源 Web 服务器，但源在默认的 125 秒代理读取超时之前未提供 HTTP 响应。如果源服务器由于有太多工作要做（例如，大型数据查询）而花费太长时间，或者因为服务器正在争夺资源并且无法及时返回任何数据，则可能会发生这种情况。如果源 Web 服务器在建立连接后确认 (ACK) 资源请求，但未及时发送响应（在代理读取超时延迟内，默认情况下为 125 秒），则会出现错误 524。

records.title: Error 1001: DNS resolution error
records.message: 此错误表示 DNS 解析失败，阻止访问所请求的域。 - Web 请求发送到不存在的 Cloudflare 域的 Cloudflare IP 地址。 - 未使用 Cloudflare 的外部域具有 Cloudflare 上活动域的 CNAME 记录 - DNS CNAME 记录的目标无法解析。 - Cloudflare DNS 应用程序中的 CNAME 记录需要通过当前离线的 DNS 提供商进行解析。
records.original_message: This error indicates a DNS resolution failure preventing access to the requested domain. - A web request was sent to a Cloudflare IP address for a non-existent Cloudflare domain. - An external domain that is not on using Cloudflare has a CNAME record to a domain active on Cloudflare - The target of the DNS CNAME record does not resolve. - A CNAME record in your Cloudflare DNS app requires resolution via a DNS provider that is currently offline.
records.situation: 此错误表示 DNS 解析失败，阻止访问所请求的域。 - Web 请求发送到不存在的 Cloudflare 域的 Cloudflare IP 地址。 - 未使用 Cloudflare 的外部域具有 Cloudflare 上活动域的 CNAME 记录 - DNS CNAME 记录的目标无法解析。 - Cloudflare DNS 应用程序中的 CNAME 记录需要通过当前离线的 DNS 提供商进行解析。

records.title: Error 1019: Compute server error
records.message: 此错误表示与 Cloudflare Worker 相关的计算服务器错误。 Cloudflare Worker 脚本递归引用自身。
records.original_message: This error indicates a compute server error related to a Cloudflare Worker. A Cloudflare Worker script recursively references itself.
records.situation: 此错误表示与 Cloudflare Worker 相关的计算服务器错误。 Cloudflare Worker 脚本递归引用自身。

records.title: Error 1020: Access denied
records.message: 此错误表示网站所有者配置的 Cloudflare 安全功能阻止了该请求。 Cloudflare 返回它并带有 HTTP 403 状态代码。具有 _Block_ 操作的安全规则与请求匹配，并且该规则未配置自定义响应。例如，API Shield 架构验证和 JWT 验证可以阻止出现 1020 错误的请求。
records.original_message: This error indicates that a Cloudflare security feature configured by the website owner blocked the request. Cloudflare returns it with an HTTP 403 status code. A security rule with a _Block_ action matched the request, and the rule has no custom response configured. For example, API Shield schema validation and JWT validation can block requests with a 1020 error.
records.situation: 此错误表示网站所有者配置的 Cloudflare 安全功能阻止了该请求。 Cloudflare 返回它并带有 HTTP 403 状态代码。具有 _Block_ 操作的安全规则与请求匹配，并且该规则未配置自定义响应。例如，API Shield 架构验证和 JWT 验证可以阻止出现 1020 错误的请求。

records.title: Error 1023: Could not find host
records.message: 此错误表示由于配置问题或传播延迟而无法找到主机。 - 如果所有者刚刚注册 Cloudflare，则可能需要几分钟时间才能将网站信息分发到我们的全球网络。站点配置有问题。 - 通常，当帐户已与合作伙伴组织（例如托管提供商）注册并且提供商的 DNS 出现故障时，就会发生这种情况。
records.original_message: This error indicates that the host could not be found due to a configuration issue or propagation delay. - If the owner just signed up for Cloudflare it can take a few minutes for the website's information to be distributed to our global network. Something is wrong with the site's configuration. - Usually, this happens when accounts have been signed up with a partner organization (for example, hosting provider) and the provider's DNS fails.
records.situation: 此错误表示由于配置问题或传播延迟而无法找到主机。 - 如果所有者刚刚注册 Cloudflare，则可能需要几分钟时间才能将网站信息分发到我们的全球网络。站点配置有问题。 - 通常，当帐户已与合作伙伴组织（例如托管提供商）注册并且提供商的 DNS 出现故障时，就会发生这种情况。

records.title: Error 1025: Please check back later

records.original_message: This error indicates that the domain has reached its plan limits for Cloudflare Workers. A request is not serviced because the domain has reached plan limits for Cloudflare Workers.
records.situation: 此错误表明该域已达到 Cloudflare Workers 的计划限制。由于域已达到 Cloudflare Workers 的计划限制，请求未得到服务。

records.title: Error 1033: Cloudflare Tunnel error
records.message: 此错误表明 Cloudflare Tunnel 存在问题。您已请求 Cloudflare 网络上的网站 (tunnel.example.com) 上的页面。主机 (tunnel.example.com) 配置了 Cloudflare Tunnel，Cloudflare 目前无法解析它。
records.original_message: This error indicates an issue with Cloudflare Tunnel. You have requested a page on a website (tunnel.example.com) that is on the Cloudflare network. The host (tunnel.example.com) is configured with Cloudflare Tunnel, and Cloudflare is currently unable to resolve it.
records.situation: 此错误表明 Cloudflare Tunnel 存在问题。您已请求 Cloudflare 网络上的网站 (tunnel.example.com) 上的页面。主机 (tunnel.example.com) 配置了 Cloudflare Tunnel，Cloudflare 目前无法解析它。

records.title: Error 1034: Edge IP Restricted
records.message: 此错误表明用于域的 IP 地址受到 Cloudflare 边缘验证的限制。边缘 IP 验证 (EIV) 是对受限 IP 空间的保护措施，旨在由特定 Cloudflare 帐户使用，例如 BYOIP 前缀、专用/静态 IP 分配或其他与客户相关的 IP 范围。启用 EIV 后，Cloudflare 会在允许请求继续之前检查这些 IP 的传入流量是否与授权帐户关联。这有助于防止意外错误路由或未经授权使用专用 IP 空间，同时保持正确配置的流量正常流动。
records.original_message: This error indicates that the IP address used for the domain is restricted by Cloudflare's edge validation. Edge IP Validation (EIV) is a safeguard for restricted IP space that is meant to be used by specific Cloudflare accounts, such as BYOIP prefixes, dedicated/static IP allocations, or other customer-associated IP ranges. When EIV is enabled, Cloudflare checks whether incoming traffic to those IPs is associated with an authorized account before allowing the request to proceed. This helps prevent accidental misrouting or unauthorized use of dedicated IP space while keeping properly configured traffic flowing normally.
records.situation: 此错误表明用于域的 IP 地址受到 Cloudflare 边缘验证的限制。边缘 IP 验证 (EIV) 是对受限 IP 空间的保护措施，旨在由特定 Cloudflare 帐户使用，例如 BYOIP 前缀、专用/静态 IP 分配或其他与客户相关的 IP 范围。启用 EIV 后，Cloudflare 会在允许请求继续之前检查这些 IP 的传入流量是否与授权帐户关联。这有助于防止意外错误路由或未经授权使用专用 IP 空间，同时保持正确配置的流量正常流动。

records.original_message: This error indicates an invalid URI path in a request rewrite. The value or expression of your rewritten URI path is not valid.
records.situation: 此错误指示请求重写中的 URI 路径无效。重写的 URI 路径的值或表达式无效。

records.title: Error 1036: Invalid request rewrite (maximum length exceeded)

records.original_message: This error indicates that the rewritten URI path or query string exceeds the maximum allowed length. The value or expression of your rewritten URI path or query string is too long.
records.situation: 此错误表明重写的 URI 路径或查询字符串超出了允许的最大长度。重写的 URI 路径或查询字符串的值或表达式太长。

records.title: Error 1037: Invalid rewrite rule (failed to evaluate expression)
records.message: 此错误表明无法评估重写规则表达式。导致此错误的原因有多种，但这可能意味着一个表达式元素在求值时包含未定义的值。
records.original_message: This error indicates that the rewrite rule expression could not be evaluated. There are several causes for this error, but it can mean that one expression element contained an undefined value when it was evaluated.
records.situation: 此错误表明无法评估重写规则表达式。导致此错误的原因有多种，但这可能意味着一个表达式元素在求值时包含未定义的值。

records.situation: 此错误表明尝试修改受限制的 HTTP 标头。您正在尝试修改请求标头转换规则无法更改的 HTTP 标头。

records.title: Error 1041: Invalid request rewrite (invalid header value)

records.title: Error 1102: Worker exceeded resource limits
records.message: 此错误表示 Cloudflare Worker 已超出其 CPU 时间限制或内存限制。 Cloudflare Worker 超出了 CPU 时间限制。 CPU 时间是执行代码（例如循环、解析 JSON 等）所花费的时间。网络请求（获取、响应）所花费的时间不计入 CPU 时间。
records.original_message: This error indicates that a Cloudflare Worker has exceeded its CPU time limit or memory limit. A Cloudflare Worker exceeds a CPU time limit. CPU time is the time spent executing code (for example, loops, parsing JSON, etc). Time spent on network requests (fetching, responding) does not count towards CPU time.
records.situation: 此错误表示 Cloudflare Worker 已超出其 CPU 时间限制或内存限制。 Cloudflare Worker 超出了 CPU 时间限制。 CPU 时间是执行代码（例如循环、解析 JSON 等）所花费的时间。网络请求（获取、响应）所花费的时间不计入 CPU 时间。

records.title: FAILED PRECONDITION
records.message: 操作被拒绝，因为系统未处于操作执行所需的状态。  例如，要删除的目录非空，rmdir 操作应用于非目录等。服务实现者可以使用以下准则来决定“FAILED_PRECONDITION”、“ABORTED”和“UNAVAILABLE”： (a) 如果客户端可以仅重试失败的调用，则使用“UNAVAILABLE”。 (b) 如果客户端应在更高级别重试，请使用“ABORTED”。例如，当客户端指定的测试和设置失败时，指示客户端应重新启动读取-修改-写入序列。 (c) 如果客户端在系统状态明确修复之前不应重试，请使用“FAILED_PRECONDITION”。例如，如果“rmdir”由于目录非空而失败，则应返回“FAILED_PRECONDITION”，因为除非从目录中删除文件，否则客户端不应重试。  HTTP 映射：400 错误请求
records.original_message: The operation was rejected because the system is not in a state required for the operation's execution.  For example, the directory to be deleted is non-empty, an rmdir operation is applied to a non-directory, etc.  Service implementors can use the following guidelines to decide between `FAILED_PRECONDITION`, `ABORTED`, and `UNAVAILABLE`: (a) Use `UNAVAILABLE` if the client can retry just the failing call. (b) Use `ABORTED` if the client should retry at a higher level. For example, when a client-specified test-and-set fails, indicating the client should restart a read-modify-write sequence. (c) Use `FAILED_PRECONDITION` if the client should not retry until the system state has been explicitly fixed. For example, if an "rmdir" fails because the directory is non-empty, `FAILED_PRECONDITION` should be returned since the client should not retry unless the files are deleted from the directory. records.title: OUT OF RANGE

records.original_message: The operation was attempted past the valid range.  E.g., seeking or reading past end-of-file. For example, a 32-bit file system will generate `INVALID_ARGUMENT` if asked to read at an offset that is not in the range [0,2^32-1], but it will generate `OUT_OF_RANGE` if asked to read from an offset past the current file size.  There is a fair bit of overlap between `FAILED_PRECONDITION` and `OUT_OF_RANGE`.  We recommend using `OUT_OF_RANGE` (the more specific error) when it applies so that callers who are iterating through a space can easily look for an `OUT_OF_RANGE` error to detect when they are done.  HTTP Mapping: 400 Bad Request

Check with the developers of the resource and application to understand what the right setup for your tenant is.

records.title: BadResourceRequest
records.message: BadResourceRequest - 要兑换访问令牌的代码，应用程序应向 /token 端点发送 POST 请求。此外，在此之前，您应该提供授权代码并将其在 POST 请求中发送到 /token 端点。请参阅本文以了解 OAuth 2.0 授权代码流程的概述。将用户定向到 /authorize 端点，该端点将返回授权码。通过向 /token 端点发布请求，用户可以获得访问令牌。检查应用程序注册 > 端点以确认两个端点配置正确。
records.original_message: BadResourceRequest - To redeem the code for an access token, the app should send a POST request to the /token endpoint. Also, prior to this, you should provide an authorization code and send it in the POST request to the /token endpoint. Refer to this article for an overview of OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Direct the user to the /authorize endpoint, which will return an authorization_code. By posting a request to the /token endpoint, the user gets the access token. Check App registrations > Endpoints to confirm that the two endpoints were configured correctly.
records.situation: BadResourceRequest - 要兑换访问令牌的代码，应用程序应向 /token 端点发送 POST 请求。此外，在此之前，您应该提供授权代码并将其在 POST 请求中发送到 /token 端点。请参阅本文以了解 OAuth 2.0 授权代码流程的概述。将用户定向到 /authorize 端点，该端点将返回授权码。通过向 /token 端点发布请求，用户可以获得访问令牌。检查应用程序注册 > 端点以确认两个端点配置正确。

records.title: BadResourceRequestInvalidRequest
records.message: BadResourceRequestInvalidRequest - 端点仅接受 {valid_verbs} 请求。收到 {invalid_verb} 请求。 {valid_verbs} 表示端点支持的 HTTP 动词列表（例如，POST），{invalid_verbs} 是当前请求中使用的 HTTP 动词（例如，GET）。这可能是由于开发人员错误，或者由于用户按下浏览器中的后退按钮，触发了错误的请求。可以忽略不计。
records.original_message: BadResourceRequestInvalidRequest - The endpoint only accepts {valid_verbs} requests. Received a {invalid_verb} request. {valid_verbs} represents a list of HTTP verbs supported by the endpoint (for example, POST), {invalid_verb} is an HTTP verb used in the current request (for example, GET). This can be due to developer error, or due to users pressing the back button in their browser, triggering a bad request. It can be ignored.
records.situation: BadResourceRequestInvalidRequest - 端点仅接受 {valid_verbs} 请求。收到 {invalid_verb} 请求。 {valid_verbs} 表示端点支持的 HTTP 动词列表（例如，POST），{invalid_verbs} 是当前请求中使用的 HTTP 动词（例如，GET）。这可能是由于开发人员错误，或者由于用户按下浏览器中的后退按钮，触发了错误的请求。可以忽略不计。

records.title: PassThroughUserMfaError
records.message: PassThroughUserMfaError - 用户登录时使用的外部帐户在他们登录的租户中不存在；因此用户无法满足租户的MFA要求。如果用户已同步，但 Active Directory 和 Microsoft Entra ID 之间的 ImmutableID (sourceAnchor) 属性不匹配，也可能会出现此错误。必须首先将该帐户添加为租户中的外部用户。注销并使用不同的 Microsoft Entra 用户帐户登录。有关更多信息，请访问配置外部身份。
records.original_message: PassThroughUserMfaError - The external account that the user signs in with doesn't exist on the tenant that they signed into; so the user can't satisfy the MFA requirements for the tenant. This error also might occur if the users are synced, but there is a mismatch in the ImmutableID (sourceAnchor) attribute between Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. The account must be added as an external user in the tenant first. Sign out and sign in with a different Microsoft Entra user account. For more information, please visit configuring external identities.
records.situation: PassThroughUserMfaError - 用户登录时使用的外部帐户在他们登录的租户中不存在；因此用户无法满足租户的MFA要求。如果用户已同步，但 Active Directory 和 Microsoft Entra ID 之间的 ImmutableID (sourceAnchor) 属性不匹配，也可能会出现此错误。必须首先将该帐户添加为租户中的外部用户。注销并使用不同的 Microsoft Entra 用户帐户登录。有关更多信息，请访问配置外部身份。

records.title: ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_SERVICE_SID_TYPE

records.original_message: The service start failed since one or more services in the same process have an incompatible service SID type setting. A service with restricted service SID type can only coexist in the same process with other services with a restricted SID type. If the service SID type for this service was just configured, the hosting process must be restarted in order to start this service. On Windows Server 2003 and Windows XP, an unrestricted service cannot coexist in the same process with other services. The service with the unrestricted service SID type must be moved to an owned process in order to start this service.
records.situation: 由于同一进程中的一个或多个服务具有不兼容的服务 SID 类型设置，服务启动失败。具有受限服务SID类型的服务只能与具有受限SID类型的其他服务共存于同一进程中。如果刚刚配置了该服务的服务 SID 类型，则必须重新启动托管进程才能启动该服务。在 Windows Server 2003 和 Windows XP 上，不受限制的服务不能与其他服务共存于同一进程中。必须将具有不受限制的服务 SID 类型的服务移至拥有的进程才能启动该服务。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_EVICT_WITHOUT_CLEANUP

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_PARAMETER_MISMATCH

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_CANT_CREATE_DUP_CLUSTER_NAME

records.title: ERROR_CLUSCFG_ROLLBACK_FAILED

records.title: ERROR_CLUSCFG_SYSTEM_DISK_DRIVE_LETTER_CONFLICT

records.situation: 群集中的一个或多个节点正在运行不支持此操作的 Windows 版本。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_MISMATCHED_COMPUTER_ACCT_NAME

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_NO_NET_ADAPTERS

records.situation: 没有可用的网络适配器。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_POISONED

records.situation: 集群节点中毒。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_GROUP_MOVING
records.message: 该组无法接受请求，因为它正在移动到另一个节点。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_RESOURCE_TYPE_BUSY

records.situation: 该资源类型无法接受请求，因为正忙于执行其他操作。

records.title: ERROR_RESOURCE_CALL_TIMED_OUT

records.title: ERROR_INVALID_CLUSTER_IPV6_ADDRESS

records.original_message: The address is not valid for an IPv6 Address resource. A global IPv6 address is required, and it must match a cluster network. Compatibility addresses are not permitted.
records.situation: 该地址对于 IPv6 地址资源无效。需要全局 IPv6 地址，并且它必须与集群网络匹配。不允许使用兼容地址。

records.situation: 发生内部集群错误。尝试调用无效函数。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_PARAMETER_OUT_OF_BOUNDS

records.situation: 参数值超出可接受的范围。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_PARTIAL_SEND

records.original_message: A network error occurred while sending data to another node in the cluster. The number of bytes transmitted was less than required.
records.situation: 向集群中的另一个节点发送数据时发生网络错误。传输的字节数低于要求。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_REGISTRY_INVALID_FUNCTION
records.message: 尝试了无效的集群注册表操作。
records.original_message: An invalid cluster registry operation was attempted.
records.situation: 尝试了无效的集群注册表操作。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_INVALID_STRING_TERMINATION
records.message: 输入字符串未正确终止。
records.original_message: An input string of characters is not properly terminated.
records.situation: 输入字符串未正确终止。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_INVALID_STRING_FORMAT
records.message: 输入字符串对于它所表示的数据来说不是有效的格式。

records.situation: 输入字符串对于它所表示的数据来说不是有效的格式。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_DATABASE_TRANSACTION_IN_PROGRESS
records.message: 发生内部集群错误。当事务已在进行时尝试执行集群数据库事务。
records.original_message: An internal cluster error occurred. A cluster database transaction was attempted while a transaction was already in progress.
records.situation: 发生内部集群错误。当事务已在进行时尝试执行集群数据库事务。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_DATABASE_TRANSACTION_NOT_IN_PROGRESS
records.message: 发生内部集群错误。尝试在没有事务正在进行时提交集群数据库事务。

records.situation: 发生内部集群错误。尝试在没有事务正在进行时提交集群数据库事务。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_NULL_DATA

records.situation: 发生内部集群错误。数据未正确初始化。

records.situation: 从数据流读取时发生错误。返回了意外的字节数。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_PARTIAL_WRITE

records.situation: 写入数据流时发生错误。无法写入所需的字节数。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_CANT_DESERIALIZE_DATA

records.original_message: An error occurred while deserializing a stream of cluster data.
records.situation: 反序列化集群数据流时发生错误。

records.title: ERROR_DEPENDENT_RESOURCE_PROPERTY_CONFLICT

records.situation: 该资源的一个或多个属性值与其从属资源关联的一个或多个属性值相冲突。

records.situation: 不存在形成集群所需的集群节点法定人数。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_INVALID_IPV6_NETWORK
records.message: 群集网络对于 IPv6 地址资源无效，或者与配置的地址不匹配。
records.original_message: The cluster network is not valid for an IPv6 Address resource, or it does not match the configured address.

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_INVALID_IPV6_TUNNEL_NETWORK
records.message: 群集网络对于 IPv6 隧道资源无效。检查IPv6 Tunnel资源所依赖的IP地址资源的配置。

records.title: ERROR_QUORUM_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_THIS_GROUP

records.situation: 仲裁资源不能驻留在可用存储组中。

records.title: ERROR_DEPENDENCY_TREE_TOO_COMPLEX

records.situation: 该资源的依赖关系嵌套得太深。

records.situation: 对资源 DLL 的调用引发了未处理的异常。

records.situation: RHS 进程初始化失败。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_NOT_INSTALLED

records.situation: 此节点上未安装故障转移群集功能。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_RESOURCES_MUST_BE_ONLINE_ON_THE_SAME_NODE

records.message: 该集群无法被破坏。它具有非核心应用程序组，必须在销毁集群之前将其删除。

records.situation: 该集群无法被破坏。它具有非核心应用程序组，必须在销毁集群之前将其删除。

records.situation: 此时驱逐该节点是无效的。由于仲裁要求，节点驱逐将导致集群关闭。如果它是集群中的最后一个节点，则应使用 destroy cluster 命令。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_SINGLETON_RESOURCE

records.situation: 集群中只允许有一个该资源类型的实例。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_GROUP_SINGLETON_RESOURCE

records.situation: 每个资源组仅允许此资源类型的一个实例。

records.message: 该资源表明它无法在任何节点上联机。

records.situation: 该资源表明它无法在任何节点上联机。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_GROUP_BUSY

records.original_message: The current operation cannot be performed on this group at this time.
records.situation: 此时无法对该组执行当前操作。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_NOT_SHARED_VOLUME
records.message: 该目录或文件不位于群集共享卷上。
records.original_message: The directory or file is not located on a cluster shared volume.
records.situation: 该目录或文件不位于群集共享卷上。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_INVALID_SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR
records.message: 安全描述符不满足集群的要求。

records.situation: 安全描述符不满足集群的要求。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_SHARED_VOLUMES_IN_USE

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_USE_SHARED_VOLUMES_API

records.situation: 无法直接操作该组或资源。使用共享卷 API 来执行所需的操作。

records.title: ERROR_CLUSTER_BACKUP_IN_PROGRESS
records.message: 备份正在进行中。请等待备份完成，然后再尝试此操作。
records.original_message: Back up is in progress. Please wait for backup completion before trying this operation again.
records.situation: 备份正在进行中。请等待备份完成，然后再尝试此操作。

records.title: ERROR_NON_CSV_PATH
records.message: 该路径不属于群集共享卷。
records.original_message: The path does not belong to a cluster shared volume.
records.situation: 该路径不属于群集共享卷。

records.title: ERROR_CSV_VOLUME_NOT_LOCAL

records.situation: 该资源否决了该呼叫。

records.message: 日志服务在尝试从日志容器读取时遇到错误。
records.original_message: Log service encountered an error when attempting to read from a log container.
records.situation: 日志服务在尝试从日志容器读取时遇到错误。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_CONTAINER_WRITE_FAILED
records.message: 日志服务在尝试写入日志容器时遇到错误。
records.original_message: Log service encountered an error when attempting to write to a log container.
records.situation: 日志服务在尝试写入日志容器时遇到错误。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_CONTAINER_OPEN_FAILED
records.message: 日志服务在尝试打开日志容器时遇到错误。
records.original_message: Log service encountered an error when attempting open a log container.
records.situation: 日志服务在尝试打开日志容器时遇到错误。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_CONTAINER_STATE_INVALID
records.message: 日志服务在尝试请求的操作时遇到无效的容器状态。
records.original_message: Log service encountered an invalid container state when attempting a requested action.
records.situation: 日志服务在尝试请求的操作时遇到无效的容器状态。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_STATE_INVALID
records.message: 日志服务未处于执行请求操作的正确状态。
records.original_message: Log service is not in the correct state to perform a requested action.
records.situation: 日志服务未处于执行请求操作的正确状态。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_PINNED
records.message: 由于日志已固定，因此无法回收日志空间。
records.original_message: Log space cannot be reclaimed because the log is pinned.
records.situation: 由于日志已固定，因此无法回收日志空间。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_METADATA_FLUSH_FAILED
records.message: 日志元数据刷新失败。
records.original_message: Log metadata flush failed.
records.situation: 日志元数据刷新失败。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_INCONSISTENT_SECURITY
records.message: 日志及其容器的安全性不一致。
records.original_message: Security on the log and its containers is inconsistent.
records.situation: 日志及其容器的安全性不一致。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_APPENDED_FLUSH_FAILED
records.message: 记录已附加到日志或进行了保留更改，但无法刷新日志。
records.original_message: Records were appended to the log or reservation changes were made, but the log could not be flushed.
records.situation: 记录已附加到日志或进行了保留更改，但无法刷新日志。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_PINNED_RESERVATION
records.message: 由于预留消耗了大部分日志空间，日志被固定。释放一些保留的记录以腾出可用空间。
records.original_message: The log is pinned due to reservation consuming most of the log space. Free some reserved records to make space available.
records.situation: 由于预留消耗了大部分日志空间，日志被固定。释放一些保留的记录以腾出可用空间。

records.title: ERROR_INVALID_TRANSACTION
records.message: 与此操作关联的事务句柄无效。
records.original_message: The transaction handle associated with this operation is not valid.
records.situation: 与此操作关联的事务句柄无效。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_NOT_ACTIVE
records.message: 所请求的操作是在不再活动的事务上下文中进行的。
records.original_message: The requested operation was made in the context of a transaction that is no longer active.
records.situation: 所请求的操作是在不再活动的事务上下文中进行的。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_REQUEST_NOT_VALID
records.message: 请求的操作在当前状态下的 Transaction 对象上无效。
records.original_message: The requested operation is not valid on the Transaction object in its current state.
records.situation: 请求的操作在当前状态下的 Transaction 对象上无效。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_NOT_REQUESTED
records.message: 调用者调用了响应API，但由于TM没有向调用者发出相应的请求，所以没有得到响应。
records.original_message: The caller has called a response API, but the response is not expected because the TM did not issue the corresponding request to the caller.
records.situation: 调用者调用了响应API，但由于TM没有向调用者发出相应的请求，所以没有得到响应。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_ALREADY_ABORTED
records.message: 现在执行请求的操作为时已晚，因为事务已中止。
records.original_message: It is too late to perform the requested operation, since the Transaction has already been aborted.
records.situation: 现在执行请求的操作为时已晚，因为事务已中止。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_ALREADY_COMMITTED
records.message: 由于事务已经提交，因此执行请求的操作为时已晚。
records.original_message: It is too late to perform the requested operation, since the Transaction has already been committed.
records.situation: 由于事务已经提交，因此执行请求的操作为时已晚。

records.title: ERROR_TM_INITIALIZATION_FAILED
records.message: 事务管理器无法成功初始化。不支持事务处理操作。
records.original_message: The Transaction Manager was unable to be successfully initialized. Transacted operations are not supported.
records.situation: 事务管理器无法成功初始化。不支持事务处理操作。

records.title: ERROR_RESOURCEMANAGER_READ_ONLY
records.message: 指定的 ResourceManager 没有对此事务下的资源进行任何更改或更新。
records.original_message: The specified ResourceManager made no changes or updates to the resource under this transaction.
records.situation: 指定的 ResourceManager 没有对此事务下的资源进行任何更改或更新。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_NOT_JOINED
records.message: 资源管理器已尝试准备其未成功加入的事务。
records.original_message: The resource manager has attempted to prepare a transaction that it has not successfully joined.
records.situation: 资源管理器已尝试准备其未成功加入的事务。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_SUPERIOR_EXISTS
records.message: Transaction 对象已经有一个上级登记，并且调用者尝试执行一个创建新上级的操作。只允许单一上级入伍。
records.original_message: The Transaction object already has a superior enlistment, and the caller attempted an operation that would have created a new superior. Only a single superior enlistment is allow.
records.situation: Transaction 对象已经有一个上级登记，并且调用者尝试执行一个创建新上级的操作。只允许单一上级入伍。

records.title: ERROR_CRM_PROTOCOL_ALREADY_EXISTS
records.message: RM 尝试注册一个已经存在的协议。
records.original_message: The RM tried to register a protocol that already exists.
records.situation: RM 尝试注册一个已经存在的协议。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_PROPAGATION_FAILED
records.message: 尝试传播事务失败。
records.original_message: The attempt to propagate the Transaction failed.
records.situation: 尝试传播事务失败。

records.title: ERROR_CRM_PROTOCOL_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 请求的传播协议未注册为 CRM。
records.original_message: The requested propagation protocol was not registered as a CRM.
records.situation: 请求的传播协议未注册为 CRM。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_INVALID_MARSHALL_BUFFER
records.message: 传递给 PushTransaction 或 PullTransaction 的缓冲区格式无效。
records.original_message: The buffer passed in to PushTransaction or PullTransaction is not in a valid format.
records.situation: 传递给 PushTransaction 或 PullTransaction 的缓冲区格式无效。

records.title: ERROR_CURRENT_TRANSACTION_NOT_VALID
records.message: 与线程关联的当前事务上下文不是事务对象的有效句柄。
records.original_message: The current transaction context associated with the thread is not a valid handle to a transaction object.
records.situation: 与线程关联的当前事务上下文不是事务对象的有效句柄。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 无法打开指定的 Transaction 对象，因为找不到该对象。
records.original_message: The specified Transaction object could not be opened, because it was not found.
records.situation: 无法打开指定的 Transaction 对象，因为找不到该对象。

records.title: ERROR_RESOURCEMANAGER_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 无法打开指定的 ResourceManager 对象，因为找不到该对象。
records.original_message: The specified ResourceManager object could not be opened, because it was not found.
records.situation: 无法打开指定的 ResourceManager 对象，因为找不到该对象。

records.title: ERROR_ENLISTMENT_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 无法打开指定的登记对象，因为找不到它。
records.original_message: The specified Enlistment object could not be opened, because it was not found.
records.situation: 无法打开指定的登记对象，因为找不到它。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTIONMANAGER_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 无法打开指定的 TransactionManager 对象，因为找不到该对象。
records.original_message: The specified TransactionManager object could not be opened, because it was not found.
records.situation: 无法打开指定的 TransactionManager 对象，因为找不到该对象。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTIONMANAGER_NOT_ONLINE
records.message: 无法创建或打开指定的对象，因为其关联的 TransactionManager 不在线。在打开 TransactionManager 或 ResourceManager 命名空间中的对象之前，必须通过调用 RecoverTransactionManager 恢复到其 LogFile 的末尾来使 TransactionManager 完全联机。此外，将记录写入其日志文件时发生错误可能会导致 TransactionManager 脱机。
records.original_message: The object specified could not be created or opened, because its associated TransactionManager is not online. The TransactionManager must be brought fully Online by calling RecoverTransactionManager to recover to the end of its LogFile before objects in its Transaction or ResourceManager namespaces can be opened. In addition, errors in writing records to its LogFile can cause a TransactionManager to go offline.
records.situation: 无法创建或打开指定的对象，因为其关联的 TransactionManager 不在线。在打开 TransactionManager 或 ResourceManager 命名空间中的对象之前，必须通过调用 RecoverTransactionManager 恢复到其 LogFile 的末尾来使 TransactionManager 完全联机。此外，将记录写入其日志文件时发生错误可能会导致 TransactionManager 脱机。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTIONMANAGER_RECOVERY_NAME_COLLISION
records.message: 指定的 TransactionManager 无法在 Ob 命名空间中创建其日志文件中包含的对象。因此，TransactionManager 无法恢复。
records.original_message: The specified TransactionManager was unable to create the objects contained in its logfile in the Ob namespace. Therefore, the TransactionManager was unable to recover.
records.situation: 指定的 TransactionManager 无法在 Ob 命名空间中创建其日志文件中包含的对象。因此，TransactionManager 无法恢复。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_NOT_ROOT
records.message: 无法完成在此事务对象上创建上级登记的调用，因为为登记指定的事务对象是该事务的从属分支。只有事务的根才能被征召为上级。
records.original_message: The call to create a superior Enlistment on this Transaction object could not be completed, because the Transaction object specified for the enlistment is a subordinate branch of the Transaction. Only the root of the Transaction can be enlisted on as a superior.
records.situation: 无法完成在此事务对象上创建上级登记的调用，因为为登记指定的事务对象是该事务的从属分支。只有事务的根才能被征召为上级。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_OBJECT_EXPIRED
records.message: 由于关联的事务管理器或资源管理器已关闭，因此该句柄不再有效。
records.original_message: Because the associated transaction manager or resource manager has been closed, the handle is no longer valid.
records.situation: 由于关联的事务管理器或资源管理器已关闭，因此该句柄不再有效。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_RESPONSE_NOT_ENLISTED
records.message: 无法对此上级登记执行指定的操作，因为该登记不是使用NotificationMask 中相应的完成响应创建的。
records.original_message: The specified operation could not be performed on this Superior enlistment, because the enlistment was not created with the corresponding completion response in the NotificationMask.
records.situation: 无法对此上级登记执行指定的操作，因为该登记不是使用NotificationMask 中相应的完成响应创建的。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_RECORD_TOO_LONG
records.message: 无法执行指定的操作，因为要记录的记录太长。发生这种情况的原因有两种：此事务上的登记太多，或者代表这些登记记录的组合恢复信息太长。
records.original_message: The specified operation could not be performed, because the record that would be logged was too long. This can occur because of two conditions: either there are too many Enlistments on this Transaction, or the combined RecoveryInformation being logged on behalf of those Enlistments is too long.
records.situation: 无法执行指定的操作，因为要记录的记录太长。发生这种情况的原因有两种：此事务上的登记太多，或者代表这些登记记录的组合恢复信息太长。

records.title: ERROR_IMPLICIT_TRANSACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED
records.message: 不支持隐式事务。
records.original_message: Implicit transaction are not supported.
records.situation: 不支持隐式事务。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATED
records.message: 内核事务管理器必须中止或忘记该事务，因为它阻止了前进的进程。
records.original_message: The kernel transaction manager had to abort or forget the transaction because it blocked forward progress.
records.situation: 内核事务管理器必须中止或忘记该事务，因为它阻止了前进的进程。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTIONMANAGER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
records.message: 提供的 TransactionManager 标识与 TransactionManager 日志文件中记录的标识不匹配。
records.original_message: The TransactionManager identity that was supplied did not match the one recorded in the TransactionManager's log file.
records.situation: 提供的 TransactionManager 标识与 TransactionManager 日志文件中记录的标识不匹配。

records.title: ERROR_RM_CANNOT_BE_FROZEN_FOR_SNAPSHOT
records.message: 此快照操作无法继续，因为事务资源管理器无法冻结在其当前状态。请再试一次。
records.original_message: This snapshot operation cannot continue because a transactional resource manager cannot be frozen in its current state. Please try again.
records.situation: 此快照操作无法继续，因为事务资源管理器无法冻结在其当前状态。请再试一次。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_MUST_WRITETHROUGH
records.message: 无法使用指定的 EnlistmentMask 登记事务，因为事务已完成 PrePrepare 阶段。为了确保正确性，ResourceManager 必须切换到直写模式并停止缓存该事务中的数据。仅登记后续交易阶段仍可能成功。
records.original_message: The transaction cannot be enlisted on with the specified EnlistmentMask, because the transaction has already completed the PrePrepare phase. In order to ensure correctness, the ResourceManager must switch to a write- through mode and cease caching data within this transaction. Enlisting for only subsequent transaction phases may still succeed.
records.situation: 无法使用指定的 EnlistmentMask 登记事务，因为事务已完成 PrePrepare 阶段。为了确保正确性，ResourceManager 必须切换到直写模式并停止缓存该事务中的数据。仅登记后续交易阶段仍可能成功。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_NO_SUPERIOR
records.message: 该交易没有上级征募。
records.original_message: The transaction does not have a superior enlistment.
records.situation: 该交易没有上级征募。

records.title: ERROR_HEURISTIC_DAMAGE_POSSIBLE
records.message: 提交事务的尝试已完成，但事务树的某些部分可能由于试探法而未成功提交。因此，有可能事务中修改的某些数据尚未提交，从而导致事务不一致。如果可能，请检查关联数据的一致性。
records.original_message: The attempt to commit the Transaction completed, but it is possible that some portion of the transaction tree did not commit successfully due to heuristics. Therefore it is possible that some data modified in the transaction may not have committed, resulting in transactional inconsistency. If possible, check the consistency of the associated data.
records.situation: 提交事务的尝试已完成，但事务树的某些部分可能由于试探法而未成功提交。因此，有可能事务中修改的某些数据尚未提交，从而导致事务不一致。如果可能，请检查关联数据的一致性。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTIONAL_CONFLICT
records.message: 该函数尝试使用保留供另一个事务使用的名称。
records.original_message: The function attempted to use a name that is reserved for use by another transaction.
records.situation: 该函数尝试使用保留供另一个事务使用的名称。

records.title: ERROR_RM_NOT_ACTIVE
records.message: 指定资源管理器内的事务支持未启动或由于错误而关闭。
records.original_message: Transaction support within the specified resource manager is not started or was shut down due to an error.
records.situation: 指定资源管理器内的事务支持未启动或由于错误而关闭。

records.title: ERROR_RM_METADATA_CORRUPT
records.message: RM 的元数据已损坏。 RM 将无法运行。
records.original_message: The metadata of the RM has been corrupted. The RM will not function.
records.situation: RM 的元数据已损坏。 RM 将无法运行。

records.title: ERROR_DIRECTORY_NOT_RM
records.message: 指定的目录不包含资源管理器。
records.original_message: The specified directory does not contain a resource manager.
records.situation: 指定的目录不包含资源管理器。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTIONS_UNSUPPORTED_REMOTE
records.message: 远程服务器或共享不支持事务性文件操作。
records.original_message: The remote server or share does not support transacted file operations.
records.situation: 远程服务器或共享不支持事务性文件操作。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_RESIZE_INVALID_SIZE
records.message: 请求的日志大小无效。
records.original_message: The requested log size is invalid.
records.situation: 请求的日志大小无效。

records.title: ERROR_OBJECT_NO_LONGER_EXISTS
records.message: 与句柄对应的对象（文件、流、链接）已被事务保存点回滚删除。
records.original_message: The object (file, stream, link) corresponding to the handle has been deleted by a Transaction Savepoint Rollback.
records.situation: 与句柄对应的对象（文件、流、链接）已被事务保存点回滚删除。

records.title: ERROR_STREAM_MINIVERSION_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 未找到此打开的事务处理文件的指定文件小型版本。
records.original_message: The specified file miniversion was not found for this transacted file open.
records.situation: 未找到此打开的事务处理文件的指定文件小型版本。

records.title: ERROR_STREAM_MINIVERSION_NOT_VALID
records.message: 找到指定的文件小型版本，但已失效。最可能的原因是事务保存点回滚。
records.original_message: The specified file miniversion was found but has been invalidated. Most likely cause is a transaction savepoint rollback.
records.situation: 找到指定的文件小型版本，但已失效。最可能的原因是事务保存点回滚。

records.title: ERROR_MINIVERSION_INACCESSIBLE_FROM_SPECIFIED_TRANSACTION
records.message: 迷你版本只能在创建它的事务上下文中打开。
records.original_message: A miniversion may only be opened in the context of the transaction that created it.
records.situation: 迷你版本只能在创建它的事务上下文中打开。

records.title: ERROR_CANT_OPEN_MINIVERSION_WITH_MODIFY_INTENT
records.message: 无法打开具有修改访问权限的迷你版本。
records.original_message: It is not possible to open a miniversion with modify access.
records.situation: 无法打开具有修改访问权限的迷你版本。

records.title: ERROR_CANT_CREATE_MORE_STREAM_MINIVERSIONS
records.message: 无法为此流创建更多迷你版本。
records.original_message: It is not possible to create any more miniversions for this stream.
records.situation: 无法为此流创建更多迷你版本。

records.title: ERROR_REMOTE_FILE_VERSION_MISMATCH
records.message: 远程服务器为使用事务打开的文件发送了不匹配的版本号或 Fid。
records.original_message: The remote server sent mismatching version number or Fid for a file opened with transactions.
records.situation: 远程服务器为使用事务打开的文件发送了不匹配的版本号或 Fid。

records.title: ERROR_HANDLE_NO_LONGER_VALID
records.message: 该句柄已被事务无效。最可能的原因是当事务结束或回滚到保存点时，文件上存在内存映射或打开的句柄。
records.original_message: The handle has been invalidated by a transaction. The most likely cause is the presence of memory mapping on a file or an open handle when the transaction ended or rolled back to savepoint.
records.situation: 该句柄已被事务无效。最可能的原因是当事务结束或回滚到保存点时，文件上存在内存映射或打开的句柄。

records.title: ERROR_NO_TXF_METADATA
records.message: 文件上没有事务元数据。
records.original_message: There is no transaction metadata on the file.
records.situation: 文件上没有事务元数据。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_CORRUPTION_DETECTED
records.message: 日志数据已损坏。
records.original_message: The log data is corrupt.
records.situation: 日志数据已损坏。

records.title: ERROR_CANT_RECOVER_WITH_HANDLE_OPEN
records.message: 该文件无法恢复，因为该文件上仍有一个句柄处于打开状态。
records.original_message: The file can't be recovered because there is a handle still open on it.
records.situation: 该文件无法恢复，因为该文件上仍有一个句柄处于打开状态。

records.title: ERROR_RM_DISCONNECTED
records.message: 事务结果不可用，因为负责它的资源管理器已断开连接。
records.original_message: The transaction outcome is unavailable because the resource manager responsible for it has disconnected.
records.situation: 事务结果不可用，因为负责它的资源管理器已断开连接。

records.title: ERROR_ENLISTMENT_NOT_SUPERIOR
records.message: 该请求被拒绝，因为相关入伍不是上级入伍。
records.original_message: The request was rejected because the enlistment in question is not a superior enlistment.
records.situation: 该请求被拒绝，因为相关入伍不是上级入伍。

records.title: ERROR_RECOVERY_NOT_NEEDED
records.message: 事务资源管理器已经是一致的。不需要恢复。
records.original_message: The transactional resource manager is already consistent. Recovery is not needed.
records.situation: 事务资源管理器已经是一致的。不需要恢复。

records.title: ERROR_RM_ALREADY_STARTED
records.message: 事务资源管理器已经启动。
records.original_message: The transactional resource manager has already been started.
records.situation: 事务资源管理器已经启动。

records.title: ERROR_FILE_IDENTITY_NOT_PERSISTENT
records.message: 该文件无法以事务方式打开，因为其身份取决于未解决的事务的结果。
records.original_message: The file cannot be opened transactionally, because its identity depends on the outcome of an unresolved transaction.
records.situation: 该文件无法以事务方式打开，因为其身份取决于未解决的事务的结果。

records.title: ERROR_CANT_BREAK_TRANSACTIONAL_DEPENDENCY
records.message: 该操作无法执行，因为另一个事务依赖于该属性不会更改的事实。
records.original_message: The operation cannot be performed because another transaction is depending on the fact that this property will not change.
records.situation: 该操作无法执行，因为另一个事务依赖于该属性不会更改的事实。

records.title: ERROR_CANT_CROSS_RM_BOUNDARY
records.message: 该操作将涉及具有两个事务资源管理器的单个文件，因此是不允许的。
records.original_message: The operation would involve a single file with two transactional resource managers and is therefore not allowed.
records.situation: 该操作将涉及具有两个事务资源管理器的单个文件，因此是不允许的。

records.title: ERROR_TXF_DIR_NOT_EMPTY
records.message: $Txf 目录必须为空，此操作才能成功。
records.original_message: The $Txf directory must be empty for this operation to succeed.
records.situation: $Txf 目录必须为空，此操作才能成功。

records.title: ERROR_INDOUBT_TRANSACTIONS_EXIST
records.message: 该操作将使事务资源管理器处于不一致状态，因此是不允许的。
records.original_message: The operation would leave a transactional resource manager in an inconsistent state and is therefore not allowed.
records.situation: 该操作将使事务资源管理器处于不一致状态，因此是不允许的。

records.title: ERROR_TM_VOLATILE
records.message: 由于事务管理器没有日志，该操作无法完成。
records.original_message: The operation could not be completed because the transaction manager does not have a log.
records.situation: 由于事务管理器没有日志，该操作无法完成。

records.title: ERROR_ROLLBACK_TIMER_EXPIRED
records.message: 无法计划回滚，因为先前计划的回滚已执行或已排队等待执行。
records.original_message: A rollback could not be scheduled because a previously scheduled rollback has already executed or been queued for execution.
records.situation: 无法计划回滚，因为先前计划的回滚已执行或已排队等待执行。

records.title: ERROR_TXF_ATTRIBUTE_CORRUPT
records.message: 文件或目录上的事务元数据属性已损坏且无法读取。
records.original_message: The transactional metadata attribute on the file or directory is corrupt and unreadable.
records.situation: 文件或目录上的事务元数据属性已损坏且无法读取。

records.title: ERROR_EFS_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_TRANSACTION
records.message: 由于事务处于活动状态，加密操作无法完成。
records.original_message: The encryption operation could not be completed because a transaction is active.
records.situation: 由于事务处于活动状态，加密操作无法完成。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTIONAL_OPEN_NOT_ALLOWED
records.message: 不允许在事务中打开该对象。
records.original_message: This object is not allowed to be opened in a transaction.
records.situation: 不允许在事务中打开该对象。

records.title: ERROR_LOG_GROWTH_FAILED
records.message: 尝试在事务资源管理器日志中创建空间失败。故障状态已记录在事件日志中。
records.original_message: An attempt to create space in the transactional resource manager's log failed. The failure status has been recorded in the event log.
records.situation: 尝试在事务资源管理器日志中创建空间失败。故障状态已记录在事件日志中。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTED_MAPPING_UNSUPPORTED_REMOTE
records.message: 不支持事务下的远程文件的内存映射（创建映射部分）。
records.original_message: Memory mapping (creating a mapped section) a remote file under a transaction is not supported.
records.situation: 不支持事务下的远程文件的内存映射（创建映射部分）。

records.title: ERROR_TXF_METADATA_ALREADY_PRESENT
records.message: 事务元数据已存在于该文件中且无法被取代。
records.original_message: Transaction metadata is already present on this file and cannot be superseded.
records.situation: 事务元数据已存在于该文件中且无法被取代。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_SCOPE_CALLBACKS_NOT_SET
records.message: 无法输入事务范围，因为范围处理程序尚未初始化。
records.original_message: A transaction scope could not be entered because the scope handler has not been initialized.
records.situation: 无法输入事务范围，因为范围处理程序尚未初始化。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_REQUIRED_PROMOTION
records.message: 需要升级才能允许资源管理器登记，但事务设置为禁止它。
records.original_message: Promotion was required in order to allow the resource manager to enlist, but the transaction was set to disallow it.
records.situation: 需要升级才能允许资源管理器登记，但事务设置为禁止它。

records.title: ERROR_CANNOT_EXECUTE_FILE_IN_TRANSACTION
records.message: 该文件在未解决的事务中打开以供修改，并且只能由事务处理的读取器打开以执行。
records.original_message: This file is open for modification in an unresolved transaction and may be opened for execute only by a transacted reader.
records.situation: 该文件在未解决的事务中打开以供修改，并且只能由事务处理的读取器打开以执行。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTIONS_NOT_FROZEN
records.message: 解冻冻结交易的请求被忽略，因为交易之前并未被冻结。
records.original_message: The request to thaw frozen transactions was ignored because transactions had not previously been frozen.
records.situation: 解冻冻结交易的请求被忽略，因为交易之前并未被冻结。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_FREEZE_IN_PROGRESS
records.message: 交易无法冻结，因为冻结已经在进行中。
records.original_message: Transactions cannot be frozen because a freeze is already in progress.
records.situation: 交易无法冻结，因为冻结已经在进行中。

records.title: ERROR_NOT_SNAPSHOT_VOLUME
records.message: 目标卷不是快照卷。此操作仅对作为快照安装的卷有效。
records.original_message: The target volume is not a snapshot volume. This operation is only valid on a volume mounted as a snapshot.
records.situation: 目标卷不是快照卷。此操作仅对作为快照安装的卷有效。

records.title: ERROR_NO_SAVEPOINT_WITH_OPEN_FILES
records.message: 保存点操作失败，因为文件在事务上打开。这是不允许的。
records.original_message: The savepoint operation failed because files are open on the transaction. This is not permitted.
records.situation: 保存点操作失败，因为文件在事务上打开。这是不允许的。

records.title: ERROR_DATA_LOST_REPAIR
records.message: Windows 发现文件损坏，该文件已被修复。可能发生数据丢失。
records.original_message: Windows has discovered corruption in a file, and that file has since been repaired. Data loss may have occurred.
records.situation: Windows 发现文件损坏，该文件已被修复。可能发生数据丢失。

records.title: ERROR_SPARSE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_TRANSACTION
records.message: 由于文件上的事务处于活动状态，稀疏操作无法完成。
records.original_message: The sparse operation could not be completed because a transaction is active on the file.
records.situation: 由于文件上的事务处于活动状态，稀疏操作无法完成。

records.title: ERROR_TM_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
records.message: 创建 TransactionManager 对象的调用失败，因为日志文件中存储的 Tm 标识与作为参数传入的 Tm 标识不匹配。
records.original_message: The call to create a TransactionManager object failed because the Tm Identity stored in the logfile does not match the Tm Identity that was passed in as an argument.
records.situation: 创建 TransactionManager 对象的调用失败，因为日志文件中存储的 Tm 标识与作为参数传入的 Tm 标识不匹配。

records.title: ERROR_FLOATED_SECTION
records.message: 尝试对因事务结束而浮动的节对象进行 I/O。没有有效数据。
records.original_message: I/O was attempted on a section object that has been floated as a result of a transaction ending. There is no valid data.
records.situation: 尝试对因事务结束而浮动的节对象进行 I/O。没有有效数据。

records.title: ERROR_CANNOT_ACCEPT_TRANSACTED_WORK
records.message: 由于资源不足等暂时情况，事务资源管理器当前无法接受事务工作。
records.original_message: The transactional resource manager cannot currently accept transacted work due to a transient condition such as low resources.
records.situation: 由于资源不足等暂时情况，事务资源管理器当前无法接受事务工作。

records.title: ERROR_CANNOT_ABORT_TRANSACTIONS
records.message: 事务资源管理器有太多未完成的事务，无法中止。事务资源管理器已关闭。
records.original_message: The transactional resource manager had too many transactions outstanding that could not be aborted. The transactional resource manger has been shut down.
records.situation: 事务资源管理器有太多未完成的事务，无法中止。事务资源管理器已关闭。

records.title: ERROR_BAD_CLUSTERS
records.message: 由于磁盘上的坏簇，该操作无法完成。
records.original_message: The operation could not be completed due to bad clusters on disk.
records.situation: 由于磁盘上的坏簇，该操作无法完成。

records.title: ERROR_COMPRESSION_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_TRANSACTION
records.message: 由于文件上的事务处于活动状态，压缩操作无法完成。
records.original_message: The compression operation could not be completed because a transaction is active on the file.
records.situation: 由于文件上的事务处于活动状态，压缩操作无法完成。

records.title: ERROR_VOLUME_DIRTY
records.message: 由于卷脏，操作无法完成。请运行 chkdsk 并重试。
records.original_message: The operation could not be completed because the volume is dirty. Please run chkdsk and try again.
records.situation: 由于卷脏，操作无法完成。请运行 chkdsk 并重试。

records.title: ERROR_NO_LINK_TRACKING_IN_TRANSACTION
records.message: 由于事务处于活动状态，无法完成链接跟踪操作。
records.original_message: The link tracking operation could not be completed because a transaction is active.
records.situation: 由于事务处于活动状态，无法完成链接跟踪操作。

records.title: ERROR_OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_TRANSACTION
records.message: 该操作不能在事务中执行。
records.original_message: This operation cannot be performed in a transaction.
records.situation: 该操作不能在事务中执行。

records.title: ERROR_EXPIRED_HANDLE
records.message: 该句柄不再与其事务正确关联。它可能已在事务资源管理器中打开，随后被迫重新启动。请关闭手柄并打开一个新手柄。
records.original_message: The handle is no longer properly associated with its transaction. It may have been opened in a transactional resource manager that was subsequently forced to restart. Please close the handle and open a new one.
records.situation: 该句柄不再与其事务正确关联。它可能已在事务资源管理器中打开，随后被迫重新启动。请关闭手柄并打开一个新手柄。

records.title: ERROR_TRANSACTION_NOT_ENLISTED
records.message: 无法执行指定的操作，因为资源管理器未在事务中登记。
records.original_message: The specified operation could not be performed because the resource manager is not enlisted in the transaction.
records.situation: 无法执行指定的操作，因为资源管理器未在事务中登记。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_WINSTATION_NAME_INVALID
records.message: 指定的会话名称无效。
records.original_message: The specified session name is invalid.
records.situation: 指定的会话名称无效。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_INVALID_PD
records.message: 指定的协议驱动程序无效。
records.original_message: The specified protocol driver is invalid.
records.situation: 指定的协议驱动程序无效。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_PD_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 在系统路径中找不到指定的协议驱动程序。
records.original_message: The specified protocol driver was not found in the system path.
records.situation: 在系统路径中找不到指定的协议驱动程序。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_WD_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 在系统路径中找不到指定的终端连接驱动程序。
records.original_message: The specified terminal connection driver was not found in the system path.
records.situation: 在系统路径中找不到指定的终端连接驱动程序。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_CANNOT_MAKE_EVENTLOG_ENTRY
records.message: 无法为此会话创建用于事件记录的注册表项。
records.original_message: A registry key for event logging could not be created for this session.
records.situation: 无法为此会话创建用于事件记录的注册表项。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_SERVICE_NAME_COLLISION
records.message: 系统上已存在同名的服务。
records.original_message: A service with the same name already exists on the system.
records.situation: 系统上已存在同名的服务。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_CLOSE_PENDING
records.message: 会话上的关闭操作正在挂起。
records.original_message: A close operation is pending on the session.
records.situation: 会话上的关闭操作正在挂起。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_NO_OUTBUF
records.message: 没有可用的空闲输出缓冲区。
records.original_message: There are no free output buffers available.
records.situation: 没有可用的空闲输出缓冲区。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_MODEM_INF_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 找不到 MODEM.INF 文件。
records.original_message: The MODEM.INF file was not found.
records.situation: 找不到 MODEM.INF 文件。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_INVALID_MODEMNAME
records.message: 在 MODEM.INF 中找不到调制解调器名称。
records.original_message: The modem name was not found in MODEM.INF.
records.situation: 在 MODEM.INF 中找不到调制解调器名称。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_MODEM_RESPONSE_ERROR
records.message: 调制解调器不接受发送给它的命令。验证配置的调制解调器名称是否与连接的调制解调器匹配。
records.original_message: The modem did not accept the command sent to it. Verify that the configured modem name matches the attached modem.
records.situation: 调制解调器不接受发送给它的命令。验证配置的调制解调器名称是否与连接的调制解调器匹配。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_MODEM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT
records.message: 调制解调器没有响应发送给它的命令。验证调制解调器是否已正确连接并通电。
records.original_message: The modem did not respond to the command sent to it. Verify that the modem is properly cabled and powered on.
records.situation: 调制解调器没有响应发送给它的命令。验证调制解调器是否已正确连接并通电。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_MODEM_RESPONSE_NO_CARRIER
records.message: 运营商检测失败或由于断开连接而丢失运营商。
records.original_message: Carrier detect has failed or carrier has been dropped due to disconnect.
records.situation: 运营商检测失败或由于断开连接而丢失运营商。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_MODEM_RESPONSE_NO_DIALTONE
records.message: 在要求的时间内未检测到拨号音。验证电话线是否正确连接且功能正常。
records.original_message: Dial tone not detected within the required time. Verify that the phone cable is properly attached and functional.
records.situation: 在要求的时间内未检测到拨号音。验证电话线是否正确连接且功能正常。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_MODEM_RESPONSE_BUSY
records.message: 回调时在远程站点检测到忙信号。
records.original_message: Busy signal detected at remote site on callback.
records.situation: 回调时在远程站点检测到忙信号。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_MODEM_RESPONSE_VOICE
records.message: 回调时在远程站点检测到语音。
records.original_message: Voice detected at remote site on callback.
records.situation: 回调时在远程站点检测到语音。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_TD_ERROR
records.message: 传输驱动程序错误。
records.original_message: Transport driver error.
records.situation: 传输驱动程序错误。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_WINSTATION_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 找不到指定的会话。
records.original_message: The specified session cannot be found.
records.situation: 找不到指定的会话。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_WINSTATION_ALREADY_EXISTS
records.message: 指定的会话名称已被使用。
records.original_message: The specified session name is already in use.
records.situation: 指定的会话名称已被使用。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_WINSTATION_BUSY
records.message: 您尝试执行的任务无法完成，因为远程桌面服务当前正忙。请几分钟后重试。其他用户应该仍然能够登录。
records.original_message: The task you are trying to do can't be completed because Remote Desktop Services is currently busy. Please try again in a few minutes. Other users should still be able to log on.
records.situation: 您尝试执行的任务无法完成，因为远程桌面服务当前正忙。请几分钟后重试。其他用户应该仍然能够登录。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_BAD_VIDEO_MODE
records.message: 已尝试连接到当前客户端不支持其视频模式的会话。
records.original_message: An attempt has been made to connect to a session whose video mode is not supported by the current client.
records.situation: 已尝试连接到当前客户端不支持其视频模式的会话。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_GRAPHICS_INVALID
records.message: 应用程序尝试启用 DOS 图形模式。不支持 DOS 图形模式。
records.original_message: The application attempted to enable DOS graphics mode. DOS graphics mode is not supported.
records.situation: 应用程序尝试启用 DOS 图形模式。不支持 DOS 图形模式。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_LOGON_DISABLED
records.message: 您的交互式登录权限已被禁用。请联系您的管理员。
records.original_message: Your interactive logon privilege has been disabled. Please contact your administrator.
records.situation: 您的交互式登录权限已被禁用。请联系您的管理员。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_NOT_CONSOLE
records.message: 请求的操作只能在系统控制台上执行。这通常是由于驱动程序或系统 DLL 需要直接控制台访问而导致的。
records.original_message: The requested operation can be performed only on the system console. This is most often the result of a driver or system DLL requiring direct console access.
records.situation: 请求的操作只能在系统控制台上执行。这通常是由于驱动程序或系统 DLL 需要直接控制台访问而导致的。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_CLIENT_QUERY_TIMEOUT
records.message: 客户端无法响应服务器连接消息。
records.original_message: The client failed to respond to the server connect message.
records.situation: 客户端无法响应服务器连接消息。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_CONSOLE_DISCONNECT
records.message: 不支持断开控制台会话。
records.original_message: Disconnecting the console session is not supported.
records.situation: 不支持断开控制台会话。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_CONSOLE_CONNECT
records.message: 不支持将断开连接的会话重新连接到控制台。
records.original_message: Reconnecting a disconnected session to the console is not supported.
records.situation: 不支持将断开连接的会话重新连接到控制台。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_SHADOW_DENIED
records.message: 远程控制另一个会话的请求被拒绝。
records.original_message: The request to control another session remotely was denied.
records.situation: 远程控制另一个会话的请求被拒绝。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_WINSTATION_ACCESS_DENIED
records.message: 请求的会话访问被拒绝。
records.original_message: The requested session access is denied.
records.situation: 请求的会话访问被拒绝。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_INVALID_WD
records.message: 指定的终端连接驱动程序无效。
records.original_message: The specified terminal connection driver is invalid.
records.situation: 指定的终端连接驱动程序无效。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_SHADOW_INVALID
records.message: 无法远程控制所请求的会话。这可能是因为会话已断开连接或当前没有用户登录。
records.original_message: The requested session cannot be controlled remotely. This may be because the session is disconnected or does not currently have a user logged on.
records.situation: 无法远程控制所请求的会话。这可能是因为会话已断开连接或当前没有用户登录。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_SHADOW_DISABLED
records.message: 请求的会话未配置为允许远程控制。
records.original_message: The requested session is not configured to allow remote control.
records.situation: 请求的会话未配置为允许远程控制。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_CLIENT_LICENSE_IN_USE
records.message: 您连接到此终端服务器的请求已被拒绝。您的终端服务器客户端许可证号当前正被其他用户使用。请致电您的系统管理员以获取唯一的许可证号。
records.original_message: Your request to connect to this Terminal Server has been rejected. Your Terminal Server client license number is currently being used by another user. Please call your system administrator to obtain a unique license number.
records.situation: 您连接到此终端服务器的请求已被拒绝。您的终端服务器客户端许可证号当前正被其他用户使用。请致电您的系统管理员以获取唯一的许可证号。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_CLIENT_LICENSE_NOT_SET
records.message: 您连接到此终端服务器的请求已被拒绝。尚未为此终端服务器客户端副本输入您的终端服务器客户端许可证号。请联系您的系统管理员。
records.original_message: Your request to connect to this Terminal Server has been rejected. Your Terminal Server client license number has not been entered for this copy of the Terminal Server client. Please contact your system administrator.
records.situation: 您连接到此终端服务器的请求已被拒绝。尚未为此终端服务器客户端副本输入您的终端服务器客户端许可证号。请联系您的系统管理员。

records.title: ERROR_CTX_LICENSE_NOT_AVAILABLE

records.situation: 由于缺少更新，复制同步尝试被放弃。

records.title: ERROR_DS_DRA_SHUTDOWN
records.message: 由于系统正在关闭，复制操作已终止。
records.original_message: The replication operation was terminated because the system is shutting down.
records.situation: 由于系统正在关闭，复制操作已终止。

records.title: ERROR_DS_DRA_INCOMPATIBLE_PARTIAL_SET
records.message: 同步尝试失败，因为目标 DC 当前正在等待从源同步新的部分属性。如果最近的架构更改修改了部分属性集，则这种情况是正常的。目标部分属性集不是源部分属性集的子集。
records.original_message: Synchronization attempt failed because the destination DC is currently waiting to synchronize new partial attributes from source. This condition is normal if a recent schema change modified the partial attribute set. The destination partial attribute set is not a subset of source partial attribute set.
records.situation: 同步尝试失败，因为目标 DC 当前正在等待从源同步新的部分属性。如果最近的架构更改修改了部分属性集，则这种情况是正常的。目标部分属性集不是源部分属性集的子集。

records.title: ERROR_DS_DRA_SOURCE_IS_PARTIAL_REPLICA
records.message: 复制同步尝试失败，因为主副本尝试从部分副本进行同步。
records.original_message: The replication synchronization attempt failed because a master replica attempted to sync from a partial replica.
records.situation: 复制同步尝试失败，因为主副本尝试从部分副本进行同步。

records.title: ERROR_DS_DRA_EXTN_CONNECTION_FAILED
records.message: 已联系为此复制操作指定的服务器，但该服务器无法联系完成该操作所需的其他服务器。
records.original_message: The server specified for this replication operation was contacted, but that server was unable to contact an additional server needed to complete the operation.
records.situation: 已联系为此复制操作指定的服务器，但该服务器无法联系完成该操作所需的其他服务器。

records.title: ERROR_DS_INSTALL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH
records.message: 源林的目录服务架构版本与此计算机上的目录服务版本不兼容。
records.original_message: The version of the directory service schema of the source forest is not compatible with the version of directory service on this computer.
records.situation: 源林的目录服务架构版本与此计算机上的目录服务版本不兼容。

records.title: ERROR_DS_DUP_LINK_ID
records.message: 架构更新失败：具有相同链接标识符的属性已存在。
records.original_message: Schema update failed: An attribute with the same link identifier already exists.
records.situation: 架构更新失败：具有相同链接标识符的属性已存在。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NAME_ERROR_RESOLVING
records.message: 名称翻译：一般处理错误。
records.original_message: Name translation: Generic processing error.
records.situation: 名称翻译：一般处理错误。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NAME_ERROR_NOT_FOUND
records.message: 姓名翻译：找不到姓名或没有足够的权限查看姓名。
records.original_message: Name translation: Could not find the name or insufficient right to see name.
records.situation: 姓名翻译：找不到姓名或没有足够的权限查看姓名。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NAME_ERROR_NOT_UNIQUE

records.original_message: Name translation: Input name mapped to more than one output name.
records.situation: 名称翻译：输入名称映射到多个输出名称。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NAME_ERROR_NO_MAPPING
records.message: 名称翻译：找到输入名称，但未找到关联的输出格式。
records.original_message: Name translation: Input name found, but not the associated output format.
records.situation: 名称翻译：找到输入名称，但未找到关联的输出格式。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NAME_ERROR_DOMAIN_ONLY
records.message: 名称翻译：无法完全解析，仅找到域名。
records.original_message: Name translation: Unable to resolve completely, only the domain was found.
records.situation: 名称翻译：无法完全解析，仅找到域名。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NAME_ERROR_NO_SYNTACTICAL_MAPPING
records.message: 名称翻译：无法在客户端执行纯粹的语法映射而无需连接网络。
records.original_message: Name translation: Unable to perform purely syntactical mapping at the client without going out to the wire.
records.situation: 名称翻译：无法在客户端执行纯粹的语法映射而无需连接网络。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CONSTRUCTED_ATT_MOD
records.message: 不允许修改构造的属性。
records.original_message: Modification of a constructed attribute is not allowed.
records.situation: 不允许修改构造的属性。

records.title: ERROR_DS_WRONG_OM_OBJ_CLASS
records.message: 对于具有指定语法的属性，指定的 OM 对象类不正确。
records.original_message: The OM-Object-Class specified is incorrect for an attribute with the specified syntax.
records.situation: 对于具有指定语法的属性，指定的 OM 对象类不正确。

records.title: ERROR_DS_DRA_REPL_PENDING
records.message: 复制请求已发布；等待回复。
records.original_message: The replication request has been posted; waiting for reply.
records.situation: 复制请求已发布；等待回复。

records.title: ERROR_DS_DS_REQUIRED
records.message: 请求的操作需要目录服务，但没有可用的。
records.original_message: The requested operation requires a directory service, and none was available.
records.situation: 请求的操作需要目录服务，但没有可用的。

records.title: ERROR_DS_INVALID_LDAP_DISPLAY_NAME
records.message: 类或属性的 LDAP 显示名称包含非 ASCII 字符。
records.original_message: The LDAP display name of the class or attribute contains non-ASCII characters.
records.situation: 类或属性的 LDAP 显示名称包含非 ASCII 字符。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NON_BASE_SEARCH
records.message: 请求的搜索操作仅支持基本搜索。
records.original_message: The requested search operation is only supported for base searches.
records.situation: 请求的搜索操作仅支持基本搜索。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CANT_RETRIEVE_ATTS
records.message: 搜索未能从数据库检索属性。
records.original_message: The search failed to retrieve attributes from the database.
records.situation: 搜索未能从数据库检索属性。

records.title: ERROR_DS_BACKLINK_WITHOUT_LINK
records.message: 架构更新操作尝试添加没有相应前向链接的反向链接属性。
records.original_message: The schema update operation tried to add a backward link attribute that has no corresponding forward link.
records.situation: 架构更新操作尝试添加没有相应前向链接的反向链接属性。

records.title: ERROR_DS_EPOCH_MISMATCH
records.message: 跨域移动的源和目标在对象的纪元号上不一致。源或目标不具有该对象的最新版本。
records.original_message: Source and destination of a cross-domain move do not agree on the object's epoch number. Either source or destination does not have the latest version of the object.
records.situation: 跨域移动的源和目标在对象的纪元号上不一致。源或目标不具有该对象的最新版本。

records.title: ERROR_DS_SRC_NAME_MISMATCH
records.message: 跨域移动的源和目标在对象的当前名称上不一致。源或目标不具有该对象的最新版本。
records.original_message: Source and destination of a cross-domain move do not agree on the object's current name. Either source or destination does not have the latest version of the object.
records.situation: 跨域移动的源和目标在对象的当前名称上不一致。源或目标不具有该对象的最新版本。

records.title: ERROR_DS_SRC_AND_DST_NC_IDENTICAL
records.message: 跨域移动操作的源和目标是相同的。调用者应使用本地移动操作而不是跨域移动操作。
records.original_message: Source and destination for the cross-domain move operation are identical. Caller should use local move operation instead of cross-domain move operation.
records.situation: 跨域移动操作的源和目标是相同的。调用者应使用本地移动操作而不是跨域移动操作。

records.title: ERROR_DS_DST_NC_MISMATCH
records.message: 跨域移动的源和目标在林中的命名上下文上不一致。源或目标没有最新版本的分区容器。
records.original_message: Source and destination for a cross-domain move are not in agreement on the naming contexts in the forest. Either source or destination does not have the latest version of the Partitions container.
records.situation: 跨域移动的源和目标在林中的命名上下文上不一致。源或目标没有最新版本的分区容器。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NOT_AUTHORITIVE_FOR_DST_NC
records.message: 跨域移动的目标对于目标命名上下文来说不具有权威性。
records.original_message: Destination of a cross-domain move is not authoritative for the destination naming context.
records.situation: 跨域移动的目标对于目标命名上下文来说不具有权威性。

records.title: ERROR_DS_SRC_GUID_MISMATCH
records.message: 跨域移动的源和目标在源对象的标识上不一致。源或目标不具有源对象的最新版本。
records.original_message: Source and destination of a cross-domain move do not agree on the identity of the source object. Either source or destination does not have the latest version of the source object.
records.situation: 跨域移动的源和目标在源对象的标识上不一致。源或目标不具有源对象的最新版本。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CANT_MOVE_DELETED_OBJECT
records.message: 已知跨域移动的对象已被目标服务器删除。源服务器没有最新版本的源对象。
records.original_message: Object being moved across-domains is already known to be deleted by the destination server. The source server does not have the latest version of the source object.
records.situation: 已知跨域移动的对象已被目标服务器删除。源服务器没有最新版本的源对象。

records.title: ERROR_DS_PDC_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS
records.message: 另一项需要对 PDC FSMO 进行独占访问的操作已经在进行中。
records.original_message: Another operation which requires exclusive access to the PDC FSMO is already in progress.
records.situation: 另一项需要对 PDC FSMO 进行独占访问的操作已经在进行中。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CROSS_DOMAIN_CLEANUP_REQD
records.message: 跨域移动操作失败，导致移动对象存在两个版本 - 源域和目标域各一个。需要删除目标对象才能将系统恢复到一致状态。
records.original_message: A cross-domain move operation failed such that two versions of the moved object exist - one each in the source and destination domains. The destination object needs to be removed to restore the system to a consistent state.
records.situation: 跨域移动操作失败，导致移动对象存在两个版本 - 源域和目标域各一个。需要删除目标对象才能将系统恢复到一致状态。

records.title: ERROR_DS_ILLEGAL_XDOM_MOVE_OPERATION
records.message: 该对象可能无法跨域边界移动，因为此类的跨域移动是不允许的，或者该对象具有一些特殊特征，例如：信任帐户或受限 RID，这会阻止其移动。
records.original_message: This object may not be moved across domain boundaries either because cross-domain moves for this class are disallowed, or the object has some special characteristics, e.g.: trust account or restricted RID, which prevent its move.
records.situation: 该对象可能无法跨域边界移动，因为此类的跨域移动是不允许的，或者该对象具有一些特殊特征，例如：信任帐户或受限 RID，这会阻止其移动。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CANT_WITH_ACCT_GROUP_MEMBERSHPS
records.message: 一旦移动，就无法跨域边界移动具有成员资格的对象，这将违反帐户组的成员资格条件。从任何帐户组成员身份中删除该对象并重试。
records.original_message: Can't move objects with memberships across domain boundaries as once moved, this would violate the membership conditions of the account group. Remove the object from any account group memberships and retry.
records.situation: 一旦移动，就无法跨域边界移动具有成员资格的对象，这将违反帐户组的成员资格条件。从任何帐户组成员身份中删除该对象并重试。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NC_MUST_HAVE_NC_PARENT
records.message: 命名上下文头必须是另一个命名上下文头的直接子节点，而不是内部节点的直接子节点。
records.original_message: A naming context head must be the immediate child of another naming context head, not of an interior node.
records.situation: 命名上下文头必须是另一个命名上下文头的直接子节点，而不是内部节点的直接子节点。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CR_IMPOSSIBLE_TO_VALIDATE
records.message: 该目录无法验证建议的命名上下文名称，因为它没有在建议的命名上下文之上保存命名上下文的副本。请确保域命名主机角色由配置为全局编录服务器的服务器担任，并且该服务器与其复制伙伴保持最新状态。 （仅适用于 Windows 2000 域名命名主机。）
records.original_message: The directory cannot validate the proposed naming context name because it does not hold a replica of the naming context above the proposed naming context. Please ensure that the domain naming master role is held by a server that is configured as a global catalog server, and that the server is up to date with its replication partners. (Applies only to Windows 2000 Domain Naming masters.)
records.situation: 该目录无法验证建议的命名上下文名称，因为它没有在建议的命名上下文之上保存命名上下文的副本。请确保域命名主机角色由配置为全局编录服务器的服务器担任，并且该服务器与其复制伙伴保持最新状态。 （仅适用于 Windows 2000 域名命名主机。）

records.title: ERROR_DS_DST_DOMAIN_NOT_NATIVE
records.message: 目标域必须处于本机模式。
records.original_message: Destination domain must be in native mode.
records.situation: 目标域必须处于本机模式。

records.title: ERROR_DS_MISSING_INFRASTRUCTURE_CONTAINER
records.message: 无法执行该操作，因为服务器在感兴趣的域中没有基础结构容器。
records.original_message: The operation cannot be performed because the server does not have an infrastructure container in the domain of interest.
records.situation: 无法执行该操作，因为服务器在感兴趣的域中没有基础结构容器。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CANT_MOVE_ACCOUNT_GROUP
records.message: 不允许非空帐户组的跨域移动。
records.original_message: Cross-domain move of non-empty account groups is not allowed.
records.situation: 不允许非空帐户组的跨域移动。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CANT_MOVE_RESOURCE_GROUP
records.message: 不允许非空资源组的跨域移动。
records.original_message: Cross-domain move of non-empty resource groups is not allowed.
records.situation: 不允许非空资源组的跨域移动。

records.title: ERROR_DS_INVALID_SEARCH_FLAG
records.message: 该属性的搜索标志无效。 ANR 位仅对 Unicode 或 Teletex 字符串的属性有效。
records.original_message: The search flags for the attribute are invalid. The ANR bit is valid only on attributes of Unicode or Teletex strings.
records.situation: 该属性的搜索标志无效。 ANR 位仅对 Unicode 或 Teletex 字符串的属性有效。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NO_TREE_DELETE_ABOVE_NC
records.message: 不允许从具有 NC 头作为后代的对象开始删除树。
records.original_message: Tree deletions starting at an object which has an NC head as a descendant are not allowed.
records.situation: 不允许从具有 NC 头作为后代的对象开始删除树。

records.title: ERROR_DS_COULDNT_LOCK_TREE_FOR_DELETE
records.message: 目录服务无法锁定树以准备删除树，因为该树正在使用中。
records.original_message: The directory service failed to lock a tree in preparation for a tree deletion because the tree was in use.
records.situation: 目录服务无法锁定树以准备删除树，因为该树正在使用中。

records.title: ERROR_DS_COULDNT_IDENTIFY_OBJECTS_FOR_TREE_DELETE
records.message: 尝试删除树时，目录服务无法识别要删除的对象列表。
records.original_message: The directory service failed to identify the list of objects to delete while attempting a tree deletion.
records.situation: 尝试删除树时，目录服务无法识别要删除的对象列表。

records.title: ERROR_DS_SAM_INIT_FAILURE
records.message: 由于以下错误，安全帐户管理器初始化失败：%1。错误状态：0x%2。请关闭此系统并重新启动到目录服务还原模式，检查事件日志以获取更多详细信息。
records.original_message: Security Accounts Manager initialization failed because of the following error: %1. Error Status: 0x%2. Please shutdown this system and reboot into Directory Services Restore Mode, check the event log for more detailed information.
records.situation: 由于以下错误，安全帐户管理器初始化失败：%1。错误状态：0x%2。请关闭此系统并重新启动到目录服务还原模式，检查事件日志以获取更多详细信息。

records.title: ERROR_DS_SENSITIVE_GROUP_VIOLATION
records.message: 只有管理员可以修改管理组的成员列表。
records.original_message: Only an administrator can modify the membership list of an administrative group.
records.situation: 只有管理员可以修改管理组的成员列表。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CANT_MOD_PRIMARYGROUPID
records.message: 无法更改域控制器帐户的主要组 ID。
records.original_message: Cannot change the primary group ID of a domain controller account.
records.situation: 无法更改域控制器帐户的主要组 ID。

records.title: ERROR_DS_ILLEGAL_BASE_SCHEMA_MOD
records.message: 尝试修改基本架构。
records.original_message: An attempt is made to modify the base schema.
records.situation: 尝试修改基本架构。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NONSAFE_SCHEMA_CHANGE
records.message: 不允许向现有类添加新的强制属性、从现有类中删除强制属性或向非反向链接属性的特殊类 Top 添加可选属性（直接或通过继承，例如通过添加或删除辅助类）。
records.original_message: Adding a new mandatory attribute to an existing class, deleting a mandatory attribute from an existing class, or adding an optional attribute to the special class Top that is not a backlink attribute (directly or through inheritance, for example, by adding or deleting an auxiliary class) is not allowed.
records.situation: 不允许向现有类添加新的强制属性、从现有类中删除强制属性或向非反向链接属性的特殊类 Top 添加可选属性（直接或通过继承，例如通过添加或删除辅助类）。

records.title: ERROR_DS_SCHEMA_UPDATE_DISALLOWED
records.message: 此 DC 上不允许架构更新，因为该 DC 不是架构 FSMO 角色所有者。
records.original_message: Schema update is not allowed on this DC because the DC is not the schema FSMO Role Owner.
records.situation: 此 DC 上不允许架构更新，因为该 DC 不是架构 FSMO 角色所有者。

records.title: ERROR_DS_CANT_CREATE_UNDER_SCHEMA
records.message: 不能在模式容器下创建此类的对象。您只能在架构容器下创建属性架构和类架构对象。
records.original_message: An object of this class cannot be created under the schema container. You can only create attribute-schema and class-schema objects under the schema container.
records.situation: 不能在模式容器下创建此类的对象。您只能在架构容器下创建属性架构和类架构对象。

records.title: ERROR_DS_INSTALL_NO_SRC_SCH_VERSION

records.original_message: The replica/child install failed to get the objectVersion attribute on the schema container on the source DC. Either the attribute is missing on the schema container or the credentials supplied do not have permission to read it.
records.situation: 副本/子安装无法获取源 DC 上架构容器的 objectVersion 属性。架构容器上缺少该属性，或者提供的凭据没有读取该属性的权限。

records.title: ERROR_DS_INSTALL_NO_SCH_VERSION_IN_INIFILE
records.message: 副本/子安装无法读取 system32 目录中文件 schema.ini 的 SCHEMA 部分中的 objectVersion 属性。
records.original_message: The replica/child install failed to read the objectVersion attribute in the SCHEMA section of the file schema.ini in the system32 directory.
records.situation: 副本/子安装无法读取 system32 目录中文件 schema.ini 的 SCHEMA 部分中的 objectVersion 属性。

records.title: ERROR_DS_INVALID_GROUP_TYPE
records.message: 指定的组类型无效。
records.original_message: The specified group type is invalid.
records.situation: 指定的组类型无效。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NO_NEST_GLOBALGROUP_IN_MIXEDDOMAIN

records.original_message: You cannot nest global groups in a mixed domain if the group is security-enabled.
records.situation: 如果全局组启用了安全性，则不能将全局组嵌套在混合域中。

records.title: ERROR_DS_NO_NEST_LOCALGROUP_IN_MIXEDDOMAIN
records.message: 如果本地组启用了安全性，则不能将本地组嵌套在混合域中。
records.original_message: You cannot nest local groups in a mixed domain if the group is security-enabled.
records.situation: 如果本地组启用了安全性，则不能将本地组嵌套在混合域中。

records.title: ERROR_DS_GLOBAL_CANT_HAVE_LOCAL_MEMBER
records.message: 全局组不能将本地组作为成员。
records.original_message: A global group cannot have a local group as a member.
records.situation: 全局组不能将本地组作为成员。

records.title: ERROR_DS_GLOBAL_CANT_HAVE_UNIVERSAL_MEMBER
records.message: 全局组不能将通用组作为成员。
records.original_message: A global group cannot have a universal group as a member.
records.situation: 全局组不能将通用组作为成员。

records.title: ERROR_DS_UNIVERSAL_CANT_HAVE_LOCAL_MEMBER
records.message: 通用组不能将本地组作为成员。

records.title: ERROR_WINHTTP_CLIENT_AUTH_CERT_NEEDED
records.message:
当服务器请求客户端身份验证时，由 WinHttpReceiveResponse 返回。 Windows Server 2003 SP1 和 Windows XP SP2：不支持此错误。

服务器需要 SSL 客户端身份验证。应用程序通过使用 WINHTTP_OPTION_CLIENT_CERT_ISSUER_LIST 选项调用 WinHttpQueryOption 来检索证书颁发者列表。有关详细信息，请参阅 WINHTTP_OPTION_CLIENT_CERT_ISSUER_LIST 选项。如果服务器请求客户端证书，但不需要它，则应用程序可以交替使用 WINHTTP_OPTION_CLIENT_CERT_CONTEXT 选项调用 WinHttpSetOption。在这种情况下，应用程序在 WinHttpSetOption 的 *lpBuffer* 参数中指定 WINHTTP_NO_CLIENT_CERT_CONTEXT 宏。有关详细信息，请参阅 WINHTTP_OPTION_CLIENT_CERT_CONTEXT 选项。 Windows Server 2003 SP1 和 Windows XP SP2：不支持此错误。
records.original_message:
Returned by WinHttpReceiveResponse when the server requests client authentication. Windows Server 2003 with SP1 and Windows XP with SP2: This error is not supported.

The server requires SSL client Authentication. The application retrieves the list of certificate issuers by calling WinHttpQueryOption with the WINHTTP_OPTION_CLIENT_CERT_ISSUER_LIST option. For more information, see the WINHTTP_OPTION_CLIENT_CERT_ISSUER_LIST option. If the server requests the client certificate, but does not require it, the application can alternately call WinHttpSetOption with the WINHTTP_OPTION_CLIENT_CERT_CONTEXT option. In this case, the application specifies the WINHTTP_NO_CLIENT_CERT_CONTEXT macro in the *lpBuffer* parameter of WinHttpSetOption. For more information, see the WINHTTP_OPTION_CLIENT_CERT_CONTEXT option. Windows Server 2003 with SP1 and Windows XP with SP2: This error is not supported.

records.title: Permission denied
records.message: EACCES（权限被拒绝）：尝试以文件访问权限禁止的方式访问文件。

records.title: Address already in use
records.message: EADDRINUSE（地址已在使用中）：尝试将服务器（net、http 或 https）绑定到本地地址失败，因为本地系统上的另一台服务器已占用该地址。
records.original_message: EADDRINUSE (Address already in use): An attempt to bind a server (net, http, or https) to a local address failed due to another server on the local system already occupying that address.

records.title: Connection refused
records.message: ECONNREFUSED（连接被拒绝）：由于目标机器主动拒绝而无法建立连接。这通常是由于尝试连接到外部主机上不活动的服务而导致的。
records.original_message: ECONNREFUSED (Connection refused): No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it. This usually results from trying to connect to a service that is inactive on the foreign host.
records.situation: ECONNREFUSED（连接被拒绝）：由于目标机器主动拒绝而无法建立连接。这通常是由于尝试连接到外部主机上不活动的服务而导致的。

records.title: Connection reset by peer
records.message: ECONNRESET（连接被对等方重置）：连接被对等方强制关闭。这通常是由于超时或重新启动导致远程套接字上的连接丢失所致。通常通过 http 和 net 模块遇到。
records.original_message: ECONNRESET (Connection reset by peer): A connection was forcibly closed by a peer. This normally results from a loss of the connection on the remote socket due to a timeout or reboot. Commonly encountered via the http and net modules.
records.situation: ECONNRESET（连接被对等方重置）：连接被对等方强制关闭。这通常是由于超时或重新启动导致远程套接字上的连接丢失所致。通常通过 http 和 net 模块遇到。

records.title: File exists
records.message: EEXIST（文件存在）：现有文件是要求目标不存在的操作的目标。
records.original_message: EEXIST (File exists): An existing file was the target of an operation that required that the target not exist.
records.situation: EEXIST（文件存在）：现有文件是要求目标不存在的操作的目标。

records.title: Is a directory
records.message: EISDIR（是目录）：操作需要一个文件，但给定的路径名是一个目录。
records.original_message: EISDIR (Is a directory): An operation expected a file, but the given pathname was a directory.
records.situation: EISDIR（是目录）：操作需要一个文件，但给定的路径名是一个目录。

records.title: Too many open files in system
records.message: EMFILE（系统中打开的文件太多）：已达到系统允许的文件描述符的最大数量，并且在至少关闭一个描述符之前无法满足对另一描述符的请求。并行打开多个文件时会遇到这种情况，特别是在进程文件描述符限制较低的系统（特别是 macOS）上。要解决下限问题，请在运行 Node.js 进程的同一 shell 中运行 ulimit -n 2048。
records.original_message: EMFILE (Too many open files in system): Maximum number of file descriptors allowable on the system has been reached, and requests for another descriptor cannot be fulfilled until at least one has been closed. This is encountered when opening many files at once in parallel, especially on systems (in particular, macOS) where there is a low file descriptor limit for processes. To remedy a low limit, run ulimit -n 2048 in the same shell that will run the Node.js process.
records.situation: EMFILE（系统中打开的文件太多）：已达到系统允许的文件描述符的最大数量，并且在至少关闭一个描述符之前无法满足对另一描述符的请求。并行打开多个文件时会遇到这种情况，特别是在进程文件描述符限制较低的系统（特别是 macOS）上。要解决下限问题，请在运行 Node.js 进程的同一 shell 中运行 ulimit -n 2048。

records.title: Broken pipe
records.message: EPIPE（损坏的管道）：对管道、套接字或 FIFO 进行写入，但没有进程读取数据。常见于网络层和 http 层，表示正在写入的流的远程端已关闭。
records.original_message: EPIPE (Broken pipe): A write on a pipe, socket, or FIFO for which there is no process to read the data. Commonly encountered at the net and http layers, indicative that the remote side of the stream being written to has been closed.
records.situation: EPIPE（损坏的管道）：对管道、套接字或 FIFO 进行写入，但没有进程读取数据。常见于网络层和 http 层，表示正在写入的流的远程端已关闭。

records.title: ambiguous argument
records.message: 函数参数的使用方式表明函数签名可能会被误解。当assert.throws(block, message)中的message参数与block抛出的错误消息匹配时，node:assert模块会抛出这个错误，因为这种用法表明用户认为message是预期的消息，而不是如果block不抛出则AssertionError将显示的消息。
records.original_message: A function argument is being used in a way that suggests that the function signature may be misunderstood. This is thrown by the node:assert module when the message parameter in assert.throws(block, message) matches the error message thrown by block because that usage suggests that the user believes message is the expected message rather than the message the AssertionError will display if block does not throw.

records.title: buffer context not available
records.message:
尝试在与 Node.js 实例不关联的 JS 引擎上下文中从插件或嵌入器代码创建 Node.js Buffer 实例。传递给 Buffer 方法的数据将在该方法返回时被释放。

遇到此错误时，创建 Buffer 实例的可能替代方法是创建一个普通的 Uint8Array，它仅在结果对象的原型上有所不同。 Uint8Array 普遍被所有 Node.js 核心 API 所接受，其中 Buffer 所在；它们在所有上下文中都可用。
records.original_message:
An attempt was made to create a Node.js Buffer instance from addon or embedder code, while in a JS engine Context that is not associated with a Node.js instance. The data passed to the Buffer method will have been released by the time the method returns.

When encountering this error, a possible alternative to creating a Buffer instance is to create a normal Uint8Array, which only differs in the prototype of the resulting object. Uint8Arrays are generally accepted in all Node.js core APIs where Buffers are; they are available in all Contexts.
records.situation:
尝试在与 Node.js 实例不关联的 JS 引擎上下文中从插件或嵌入器代码创建 Node.js Buffer 实例。传递给 Buffer 方法的数据将在该方法返回时被释放。

遇到此错误时，创建 Buffer 实例的可能替代方法是创建一个普通的 Uint8Array，它仅在结果对象的原型上有所不同。 Uint8Array 普遍被所有 Node.js 核心 API 所接受，其中 Buffer 所在；它们在所有上下文中都可用。

records.message:
当尝试 require() ES 模块时，CommonJS 到 ESM 或 ESM 到 CommonJS 边缘会参与立即循环。这是不允许的，因为 ES 模块在已经被评估时无法被评估。

为了避免循环，循环中涉及的 require() 调用不应发生在 ES 模块（通过 createRequire()）或 CommonJS 模块的顶层，而应在内部函数中延迟完成。
records.original_message:
When trying to require() an ES Module, a CommonJS to ESM or ESM to CommonJS edge participates in an immediate cycle. This is not allowed because ES Modules cannot be evaluated while they are already being evaluated.

To avoid the cycle, the require() call involved in a cycle should not happen at the top-level of either an ES Module (via createRequire()) or a CommonJS module, and should be done lazily in an inner function.
records.situation:

为了避免循环，循环中涉及的 require() 调用不应发生在 ES 模块（通过 createRequire()）或 CommonJS 模块的顶层，而应在内部函数中延迟完成。

This error has been deprecated since require() now supports loading synchronous ES modules. When require() encounters an ES module that contains top-level await, it will throw ERR_REQUIRE_ASYNC_MODULE instead.
